name: complex
description: Demo database for complex types in Oracle. One table with one column per type shape: collections, object types, JSON.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.label: Tags
attributes.description: List of text values as a VARRAY (ordered, at most 100); elements are addressed 1-based in PL/SQL, in SQL through TABLE()

attributes.name: vec
attributes.label: Vector
attributes.description: VARRAY of doubles (three values); a VARRAY has a maximum, not a fixed size

attributes.name: matrix
attributes.label: Matrix
attributes.description: A VARRAY of VARRAYs: two rows of three doubles; the first index selects the row

attributes.name: dims
attributes.label: Dimensions
attributes.description: Object type cx_dims of width and height

attributes.name: address
attributes.label: Address
attributes.description: Object type cx_address holding an object (cx_geo) and a list (phones)

attributes.name: attrs
attributes.label: Attributes
attributes.description: Map as a JSON object with text keys; Oracle has no map type

attributes.name: counts
attributes.label: Counts
attributes.description: Map as a JSON object with numeric values; Oracle has no map type

attributes.name: lookup
attributes.label: Lookup
attributes.description: Map as a JSON object; the integer keys are text, as JSON has no other

attributes.name: items
attributes.label: Items
attributes.description: Nested table of object type cx_item: sku, quantity, price and a list of options

attributes.name: events
attributes.label: Events
attributes.description: VARRAY of object type cx_event with temporal fields

attributes.name: deep
attributes.label: Deep
attributes.description: A list of maps whose values are structures holding a list and a map of lists; JSON as a whole, since it contains maps

attributes.name: doc
attributes.label: Document
attributes.description: JSON document in the native JSON type; JSON paths count from 0

attributes.name: odd
attributes.label: Odd
attributes.description: Object type cx_odd with a mixed-case attribute name that needs quoting

links.name: same_check
links.comment: both tables refer to the same data record
